title: The Duck Who Stayed
draft_line: First draft. More chapters are coming.
blurb: A small walking robot comes to a farm in a box. Wren gets a thin green book to write down what it does.

cover.alt: Wren, in a straw hat and a red shirt, kneels on a kitchen floor and holds out her hands to Pip, a small white and grey robot duck with orange feet, walking towards her.

chapters.description: Chapter 1 of The Duck Who Stayed, a first draft of a story to read aloud.

slots.after: Aunt Mo set the box on the kitchen table
slots.alt: Aunt Mo, in a blue coat and green boots, carries a cardboard box into the farmhouse kitchen. A red arrow on the box points down. In a panel beside her the same box stands open and full of white foam, and the head of a small robot duck, with a flat beak and a round orange eye, pokes through the foam.

slots.after: Pip walked. It walked like someone
slots.alt: Wren, in a straw hat and a red shirt, kneels on the kitchen floor with her arms held out. Pip, a small white and grey robot duck with orange feet, walks towards her. A dashed line on the floor runs past her and on to the leg of a chair.

slots.after: She went to find a pencil.
slots.alt: Wren sits at the kitchen table, writing in an open thin green book with a yellow pencil. Aunt Mo sits across from her with a mug. One leg of Wren's chair is wrapped in a tied bandage. Pip stands on a shelf by the back door, plugged in to charge.

chapters.description: Chapter 5 of The Duck Who Stayed, a first draft of a story to read aloud.

slots.after: Pip stood on a flat stone
slots.alt: In the farmyard, Pip stands on a flat stone with two cards laid beside it. Wren, on her knees, stretches one hand back to Tam, who holds out a card with an arrow turning right. Aunt Mo sits on a crate by the pump, cleaning a wheel. A hen walks past the gate, and beyond it is a chalk square.

slots.after: Pip tipped over and stuck there
slots.alt: A map of the yard seen from above, with paper labels. Dots show Pip's path: forward from Pip's stone, a right turn, then on to the woodpile, where Pip lies tipped over against the logs. A row of six cards lies beside the path. The gate and the chalk square are the other way, and a label shows where Wren knelt, facing the stone.

slots.after: Wren got out the green book.
slots.alt: An open green book, with a page headed Who Did It in pencil. Pip, The stone, Drift and Tam are crossed out, and Chair leg is not. Beside the list is a small drawing of a bandaged chair leg under the word Wanted. A pencil lies on the other page, and a hen walks past the book.
